title: A Normative Framework for Benchmarking Consumer Fairness in Large Language Model Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating recommendation benefit deviation (e.g., hit rate and ranking quality) by comparing outputs from a neutral ranker against a sensitive ranker that includes gender in the prompt (NSD), and by counterfactually substituting user gender in the prompts to measure changes in recommendations (NCSD).

Evaluating recommendation benefit deviation by comparing outputs from a neutral ranker against a sensitive ranker that includes age groups in the prompt (NSD), and by counterfactually substituting user age groups (e.g., Young vs. Old) in the prompts to assess recommendation fairness (NCSD).
